question: At instant t0, p is modelled as a point-particle of inertial mass 2 kg in an inertial frame R, with +x to the right. Two independently verified actuator contacts i_A and i_B supply forces (10,0,0) N and (-4,0,0) N to p. These are stipulated to be all and only the relevant interactions in this idealised example. What is p's acceleration?

exposures.definition: The acceleration of a point-particle as measured in an inertial-frame.
exposures.reason: Read the quantity's point-particle and inertial-frame requirements.

exposures.definition: A reference-frame standard for Newtonian analysis of motion; historically, a Galilean reference frame.
exposures.reason: Peripheral inertial-frame description; R is stipulated inertial in the question.

exposures.definition: For a point-particle, inertial-acceleration equals net-force divided by inertial-mass: a = F/m.
exposures.reason: Choose the acceleration orientation a = F/m.

exposures.definition: The positive scalar coefficient m such that net-force = m times inertial-acceleration for a point-particle.
exposures.reason: Positive scalar mass requirement; 2 kg is supplied, not inferred using the unknown acceleration.

exposures.definition: net-force on particle p at time t is the vector sum of the impressed-force contribution supplied to p by every interaction in the closed interaction-set for p at t.
exposures.reason: Choose the force sum instead of the inverse F = ma, which needs the unknown answer.

exposures.definition: The target-directed vector force-action that an interaction in a particle's interaction-set supplies to that particle in a fixed context; it is the contribution summed to obtain the particle's net-force.
exposures.reason: Read the target-directed force-contribution meaning; individual numerical forces are given.

exposures.definition: The closed set of all and only the independently warranted interaction|s relevant to particle p at time t; each member interaction supplies a target-directed impressed-force on p.
exposures.reason: Demand the independently warranted, closed interaction membership before summing.
